title: Shatterbelt wave state diagram
description: The waves of one Game. Separately, Game.over turns true, once and for good, in the step where every ship is out; the field goes on moving behind the game-over scenes. An attract game has no ships and never ends.

states.description: waveTimer ≥ 0: counting down to the next wave, WAVE.opening before the first and WAVE.pause after each cleared field.
waveTimer = −1: rocks are on the field.

transitions.action: startWave(wave + 1): large rocks along the edges, away from ships; emit wave.
